historical_source_roles.qualification: Full body read of exact registered native source; matches current lock-checksum archive. Actual features, application use, tree implementation and independent lenses remain open. Examples were read, not run.

observations: SpatialQuery traverses collider trees, applies query filters and fetches global Position, Rotation and Collider before native ray or shape queries. Closest-hit and multi-hit paths differ; shape cast converts native local witnesses through poses and translates the moving witness by travel distance. Native broadphase tree, Parry semantics, schedule and application query frames remain to be traced.

Multi-hit callback paths iterate each collider tree and pass callback results into each traversal; whether a false result stops all trees or only the current traversal requires the tree implementation and callers. The shape intersection path treats native contact-query errors as non-intersections via is_ok_and; supported shapes, actual error cases and caller policy are open. No missed hit or error was observed.

AABB intersection is a broad-phase bounding-box result with a tighter AABB check, whereas shape intersection performs a native contact query; do not interchange their semantics. Exact registered bytes match the current lock-checksum archive but do not establish feature resolution, runtime scheduling or current lens completion. Examples were read, not run; no product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
